pages.text: $(bold)Flying Sword$()$(br2)Obtaining: craft it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() — combining parts such as a Broad Sword Blade + a Tough Handle.$(br2)Features: a blade forged with Tinkers' Construct for sword-riding flight.$(li)$(bold)right-click to launch$() the flying sword; it automatically returns after striking an enemy$(li)equipping it in the $(bold)feet curio slot$() (Curios) grants $(bold)flight$()$(li)press the bound key (default R) to switch between $(bold)Normal / Tracking$() modes

$(bold)Tracking Mode$(): the launched sword automatically locks onto and attacks nearby enemies — the go-to mode for clearing mobs at range.$(br2)The Flying Sword is the only weapon that combines ranged attacks with aerial mobility, making it very handy for exploring high-altitude ruins (such as the Yellow Robe event).
